claim_boundary: The promoted classifications are the compact vacuum-cylinder sector split, the homogeneous neutral two-scalar clock sector, and the smooth fixed-coupling linearized positive-Berger sector on their separately declared phase spaces. Local audits prove that the neutral clock's opposite-sign ratio sector is not globally positive, while the complete standard one-field conformal stealth family has no globally regular everywhere-timelike clock. On the exact positive Berger background, the lapse constraint and compact spatial averaging force delta Q_R=0 for every allowed fixed-coupling linearized tangent; with Omega_total(delta,L_D)=omega delta Q_R this gives the scoped verdict D_GAUGE. No all-row BV, interacting, boundary, or quantum verdict is promoted.

relational_clock.result: The vacuum one-real-scalar and complete standard one-field stealth routes are obstructed. The neutral (+,-) pair gives a scoped homogeneous D_GAUGE reference-clock theorem but fails the global positive-health audit. The exact Berger-cylinder family supplies healthy standard-sign matter and nonzero clock momentum. At fixed alpha_B and lambda, the exact lapse row is proportional to delta Q_R; compact spatial averaging forces delta Q_R=0 in every smooth linearized mode. The helical presymplectic identity therefore gives D_GAUGE on the declared fixed-coupling Berger phase space. The all-row BV reduction, causal theory, and nonlinear stability remain open.
